statement_en: Let \(a>0\), \(b\in \mathbb{R}\), and \(a>|b|\). Compute the parameter-dependent integral \[I(a,b):=\int_0^{\infty}e^{-ax}J_0(bx)\,dx,\] where \(J_0(z)\) is the Bessel function of the first kind of order zero.
key_techniques: power series expansion of Bessel functions
prerequisites: justification of exchanging sum and integral
callout_body: 令$a>0,b\in \mathbb{R}$并且满足$a>|b|$，计算含参数积分$$I(a,b):=\int_0^{\infty}e^{-ax}J_0(bx)\,dx$$其中$J_0(z)$是第一类零阶贝塞尔函数。
